verdict.rationale: LlamaParse is an API-first service. It can be driven headlessly through Python, TypeScript, Go and Java SDKs, a REST API and a CLI tool, with batch processing and completion webhooks that suit unattended automation pipelines. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions), in-depth CLI documentation for non-interactive use, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: whether you prefer Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, the CLI, the REST API, or the Web UI
you can configure webhook endpoints to be notified immediately when jobs complete, fail, or reach other states
Extract is available as a web UI, Python SDK and REST API.
